title: Lab keyboard audit and repair capstone
description: Repair an intentionally inaccessible standalone workshop page across keyboard navigation, focus, names, contrast, image alternatives and reduced-motion behavior.
objectives: Repair skip links, semantic controls and visible focus
Make fields, image alternatives and status feedback understandable
Verify native modal closure and focus restoration
Test reduced motion, mobile layout and honest local-only form submission
rubric: I repaired real keyboard and focus defects, not just styles.
I tested semantic names, alt text, motion and mobile layout in Chromium.
I recorded verified behavior and limits without claiming formal WCAG certification.
